tasks.title: Essay: Student housing priorities
tasks.instruction:
In your English class you have been discussing how to improve student accommodation. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Review: Student housing service
tasks.instruction:
You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted!

Have you used the student accommodation advice service at your college? We want to hear about your experience. Write a review of the service.

Describe what support the service offers, say how helpful it was for you, and explain whether you would recommend it to other students.

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Article: Living with housemates
tasks.instruction:
You see this announcement on a student website.

Articles wanted!

Living with housemates – tips for success

What advice would you give to someone who is about to share a flat or house with other students? Write an article for our website.

Describe one common challenge of shared accommodation, suggest a practical way to avoid problems, and explain how good communication can make living together easier.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Email: Accommodation problem
tasks.instruction:
You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Maria.

Write your email.

promptBlocks.subject: My accommodation problem!
paragraphs: I'm having some issues with my student flat. The heating hasn't worked for a week, and the landlord isn't responding to my messages. I'm not sure what to do.
Can you give me some advice? What should I say to the landlord? Should I involve the college accommodation office? Also, what can I do to stay warm in the meantime?
